_doc: Task #551 §B / §E — registry of ACA Jobs that have been migrated to AWS Lambda + EventBridge. The CI guard `artifacts/syrabit-backend/scripts/check_dead_providers.py` walks `artifacts/syrabit-backend/aca_jobs/*.py` and fails the build for any module not represented here. Adding a new ACA Job without first landing its Lambda counterpart (handler + Terraform + EventBridge schedule) is a CI hard-fail.
_task_571_doc: Task #571 — `cache-effectiveness` is a *new* batch shipper, not an ACA-Jobs migration; it has no `aca_module` counterpart. Listed in `auxiliary_jobs` below so the dead-providers CI guard (which only walks `aca_jobs/*.py`) does not require an entry, while the lambda-batch-jobs.tf locals.batch_jobs table still mirrors it 1:1.

auxiliary_jobs.name: chat-credit-runway
auxiliary_jobs.notes: Daily GCP credit-runway snapshot. Queries the GCP Billing BigQuery export, computes remaining_credits / (trailing_30d_burn / 30), writes the integer to Upstash Redis at chat:credit_runway_days (TTL 48h) so cost_caps._select_chat_primary's 60s cache picks it up on the next refresh. Publishes Syrabit/Cost::ChatCreditRunwayDays to CloudWatch; chat-credit-runway-stale alarm pages on-call when the metric is missing >24h.

auxiliary_jobs.name: chat-credit-runway-freshness
auxiliary_jobs.notes: Independent Sentry-backed >24h missing-runway alert. Reads chat:credit_runway_days from Upstash Redis directly (the publisher stamps a 48h TTL, so age = publish_ttl - remaining_pttl), and sentry_sdk.capture_message's when the value is missing or older than RUNWAY_FRESHNESS_THRESHOLD_S (default 24h). Hourly cadence × Sentry first-event dedup → on-call paged within ~1h of any publisher outage. Independence from the publisher matters: if the publisher Lambda fails to invoke, this probe is the only Sentry-side detector.

auxiliary_jobs.name: cache-effectiveness
auxiliary_jobs.notes: Daily shipper for the AI-input-cache snapshot. Scrapes admin-only /api/health/cache and emits per-content-type Hits/Misses/HitRatio/UniqueKeys24h/MissReason to the Syrabit/Cache CloudWatch namespace. Two alarms ride on the (ContentType=Total) dimension: cache-ai-hitratio-low (HitRatio < 0.30 for 1 day) + cache-cardinality-spike (UniqueKeys24h > 3x the trailing 7-day moving average).
